name: Star Night Restaurant, Catering and Events

reviews.name: Anshida K
reviews.quote: Visited Star Night Restaurant recently and had a really good experience. The restaurant is clean, spacious, and has a pleasant ambience that's perfect for families and friends. The seating is comfortable, and the overall atmosphere is calm and welcoming. The food was fresh, tasty, and served in good portions.

reviews.name: Girish Nair
reviews.quote: I have been here to take away food. Mandi Biriyani and other arabian cousines are famous here. However, this hotel won't disappoint a vegetarian too.

reviews.name: RAMSHAD NELLAYA
reviews.quote: Star Night has truly outdone itself with its recent renovation! 🎉 The new theme and ambiance are absolutely stunning, creating a perfect setting for a great dining experience. 🍽️✨ The transformation is impressive, giving the place a fresh and inviting vibe.

reviews.name: Saran Udayakumar
reviews.quote: A good place to dine in and take away. They also deliver food for free. Specialists in biryani, ghee rice, mandi, porotta, alfaham, tandoori, Tikka, shawarma & broast. May be a bit crowded in late evenings. UPI payments can be done.
